ticket.title: benchwork chat context injection reads the ledger directly and goes blank in records mode
ticket.description: Found while sweeping for consumers of storypole state after ADR 0009 moved tickets into one file each. context_injector.rs:61 reads .gaugeblock/storypole/ledger.jsonl and replays it to inject task context into the chat harness. In records mode that file still exists - init creates it - but holds no events, so the injection yields nothing and the failure is silent: the chat simply has no task context, which looks like a quiet model rather than a broken reader. It needs to read whichever layout the store uses, the same way storypole workspace rollup now does (GB-330): tickets/*.json when the tickets directory exists, ledger.jsonl otherwise. Worth noting what did NOT break: capabilities.rs:100 checks ledger.is_file() OR config.toml, so storypole_active stays true, and outfeed reaches storypole through add_task/verify_task rather than the file, so it needs no change.
